mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting cytosolic breakdown to aerobic ATP renewal was most worthwhile: the illustration plan distinguishes fuel oxidation from oxygen’s role and shows the hydrogen-ion gradient driving ATP synthesis.

leastWorthwhile.text: Installing the pump was straightforward preparation; its purpose became clearer only in the subsequent transport result.

surprise.text: The aerobic pathway explicitly separates oxygen’s role from fuel oxidation and shows water forming where electron transfer ends.

arbitrary.text: Nothing I chose felt purposeless, although choosing aerobic rather than cytosolic ATP renewal for the pump was not clearly necessary from the available options.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how these cellular mechanisms build into tissues and organs; the transport and energy connections were interesting.
